verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents workflows and jobs you can create, update, run, and monitor through the Python SDK or REST endpoints. That means runs can be triggered programmatically, for example from an external cron or orchestrator. However, the evidence never mentions a built-in schedule, cron, or recurring-run setting for workflows. Missing for 10: native recurring or scheduled workflow triggers, documentation of schedule configuration (cron or intervals), independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs.
